note: Ps63 desert-longing (corrected; wilderness of Judah). Rich IB: earnest SEEK (shachar), soul THIRSTS (tsame) + flesh FAINTS (kamah) for God in dry land; BEHOLDING God's power+glory in sanctuary; PRAISE because chesed is better-than-life; BLESS God + LIFT hands in his name; soul SATISFIED (saba) as at a feast + JOYFUL praise; REMEMBER + MEDITATE on God in the night watches; SING FOR JOY under his wings; soul CLINGS (dabaq) to God (right hand upholds); enemies SEEK to destroy his life; king REJOICE + loyal EXULT. God-qualifiers=6 (power/glory/chesed/name/help/upholds). Desert + feast (fat/rich-food) + jackal/sword imagery + soul/flesh bearers = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: seek early / earnestly (shachar - earnestly I seek you)
the seeking expressed as thirst and fainting

'O God, you are my God; earnestly I SEEK (shachar) you' — the whole-hearted pursuit of God at dawn; shachar (to seek early/eagerly) the soul's first and deepest priority — God claimed as 'my God' and sought before all else, the thirst that opens the psalm
thirst (tsame - my soul thirsts for you)
as in a dry and weary land without water
paired with the flesh fainting for God

'my soul THIRSTS (tsame) for you' — spiritual longing felt as bodily thirst; tsame here the soul's craving for God as parching as desert thirst — the deepest need of the self, God alone the water that slakes it
faint / long (kamah - my flesh faints for you)

'my flesh FAINTS (kamah) for you' — the longing that reaches even the body; kamah here the whole person, soul and flesh together, pining for God — desire so total it exhausts the frame, a hunger of the entire self
look / gaze (raah - I have looked upon you in the sanctuary)
God (his power and glory), in the sanctuary
the vision that answers the thirst

'So I have LOOKED (raah) upon you in the sanctuary, beholding your power and glory' — the contemplation of God that answers the desert-thirst; raah here the gazing on God's power and glory (the qualifiers) remembered from the sanctuary — the vision the longing soul feeds on even in the wilderness
praise / laud (shabach - my lips will praise you)
the praise repeated with joyful lips (v5)
because God's steadfast love is better than life (v3)

'Because your steadfast love is better than life, my lips will PRAISE (shabach) you' — praise that flows from valuing God's love above life itself; shabach here the lauding drawn out by the supreme worth of God's chesed (the qualifier) — worship grounded in the deepest estimate of what is best
bless (barak - I will bless you as long as I live)
as long as he lives, lifting up his hands
expressed in the lifting up of hands

'So I will BLESS (barak) you as long as I live; in your name I will lift up my hands' — lifelong blessing of God; barak here the sustained worship of a whole life, expressed in uplifted hands in God's name — devotion made the constant business of living
lift up (the hands) (nasa - lift up my hands)
the gesture of the lifelong blessing

'in your name I will LIFT UP (nasa) my hands' — the bodily posture of prayer and blessing; nasa here the hands raised in God's name — the outward act of a heart lifted to God, worship enacted with the whole self
be satisfied / filled (saba - my soul will be satisfied as with fat)
as with fat and rich food

'My soul will be SATISFIED (saba) as with fat and rich food' — the thirst of v1 answered with the fullness of a feast; saba here the deep contentment of a soul filled by God — desert-longing turned to banquet-satisfaction, the richest fare found in God himself
praise (halal - my mouth will praise you with joyful lips)
the joyful praise fed by the soul's satisfaction

'and my mouth will PRAISE (halal) you with joyful lips' — praise overflowing from a satisfied soul; halal here the exultant lauding of the filled and glad heart — worship as the natural voice of contentment in God
joyful / ringing joy (renan - with joyful lips)
the joy that voices the praise

'my mouth will praise you with JOYFUL (renan) lips' — the ringing gladness that colours the praise; renan here the shout of joy on the lips — the affect of a satisfied soul, praise sung not dutifully but with exultation
remember (zakar - when I remember you upon my bed)
upon his bed, in the night
paired with meditating in the night watches

'when I REMEMBER (zakar) you upon my bed' — God the last thought of the wakeful night; zakar here the calling of God to mind in the dark hours — the mind turned Godward when the world is still, memory feeding the joy of v5
meditate / muse (hagah - meditate on you in the watches of the night)
in the watches of the night
paired with remembering on the bed

'and MEDITATE (hagah) on you in the watches of the night' — sustained musing on God through the dark hours; hagah (to murmur/ponder, cf Ps1:2) the mind dwelling on God watch after watch — wakefulness turned to communion, the night a time of nearness not fear
sing for joy / ring out (ranan - I will sing for joy)
in the shadow of God's wings
because God has been his help (v7)

'for you have been my help, and in the shadow of your wings I will SING FOR JOY (ranan)' — jubilant song sheltered under God; ranan here the ringing joy of one who has known God's help (the qualifier) and rests under his wings — safety and gladness together
cling / cleave (dabaq - my soul clings to you)
held fast by God's upholding right hand
met by God's right hand upholding him

'My soul CLINGS (dabaq) to you; your right hand upholds me' — the soul's cleaving to God, met by his grip; dabaq (to stick fast, the word for a man cleaving to his wife) the soul's total attachment to God — and the mutual hold: as the soul clings, God's right hand upholds (the qualifier), the grasp secured from both sides
seek (baqash - those who seek to destroy my life)
the murderous seeking, set against the psalmist's seeking of God (v1)

'But those who SEEK (baqash) to destroy my life shall go down into the depths' — the enemies' deadly pursuit; baqash here their hunting to destroy him — the dark mirror of his own seeking (shachar) of God (v1): he seeks God, they seek his life, and their end is the pit
rejoice / be glad (samach - the king shall rejoice in God)
paired with the exulting of all who swear by God

'But the king shall REJOICE (samach) in God' — joy anchored not in circumstance but in God himself; samach here the gladness of the king (David) whose deliverance from his life-seekers issues in rejoicing in God — the triumphant close of the desert-longing
exult / glory (halal - all who swear by him shall exult)

'all who swear by him shall EXULT (halal), for the mouths of liars will be stopped' — the loyal rejoicing when truth is vindicated; halal here the exultation of those who are God's (who swear by him) — their glorying secured as the lying mouths of the enemies are silenced
God's power, the object of the psalmist's beholding (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's power): 'beholding your POWER (oz)' - God's power is not a human IB char; the object of the psalmist's gaze in the sanctuary (281041), what his longing soul contemplates. Qualifier.
God's glory, the object of the psalmist's beholding (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's glory): 'beholding your power and GLORY (kavod)' - God's glory is not a human IB char; twin object of the psalmist's beholding (281041), the splendour his soul feeds on. Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - your steadfast love is better than life)
God's love, better than life, the ground of the psalmist's praise (v3)

v3 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'your STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) is better than life' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the supreme good the psalmist prizes above life itself, drawing out his praise (281051). Qualifier.
name (shem - in your name I will lift up my hands)
God's name, invoked in the psalmist's blessing (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's name): 'in your NAME (shem) I will lift up my hands' - God's name is not a human IB char; the name in which the psalmist blesses God and lifts his hands (281054). Qualifier.
help (ezrah - you have been my help)
God has been his help, ground of his joyful song (v7)
v7 QUALIFIER (God as help): 'for you have been my HELP (ezrah)' - God's help is not a human IB char; the deliverance that grounds the psalmist's singing for joy under his wings (281079). Qualifier.
uphold / hold fast (tamak - your right hand upholds me)
God's right hand upholds the clinging soul (v8)

v8 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'your right hand UPHOLDS (tamak) me' - God's sustaining grip is not a human IB char; the hold that answers the soul's clinging (302642) - as the soul cleaves, God's hand holds it fast. Qualifier.
soul (nefesh - my soul thirsts for you)
v1: 'my SOUL (nefesh) thirsts for you' - the bearer of the thirst; the thirsting itself is the char (281016, bearer=soul). Standalone (the thirst-bearer).
flesh / body (basar - my flesh faints for you)

v1: 'my FLESH (basar) faints for you' - the bearer of the fainting; the longing of the body is the char (281018, bearer=flesh) - the whole self, soul and flesh, pining for God. Standalone (the fainting-bearer).
dry / parched (tsiyyah - a dry and weary land)
v1: 'as in a DRY (tsiyyah) and weary land where there is no water' - the desert image of the psalmist's spiritual thirst; the parched land mirroring the soul's craving. Standalone (image).
v1: 'a dry and WEARY (ayeph) land where there is no water' - the exhausted, waterless waste imaging the thirst for God; the desert setting of the longing. Standalone (image).
sanctuary / holy place (qodesh - looked upon you in the sanctuary)

v2: 'I have looked upon you in the SANCTUARY (qodesh)' - the holy place where the psalmist beheld God's power and glory; the setting of the vision (the beholding is the char, 281041). Standalone (place).
behold / gaze (chazah - beholding your power and glory)

v2: 'BEHOLDING (chazah) your power and glory' - the act of gazing on God, parallel to 'looked' (281041, the char); the same contemplation, its object God's power and glory. Standalone (the beholding, in the looked char).
v3: 'your steadfast love is BETTER (tob) than life' - the supreme valuation of God's love above life itself; the comparative estimate that grounds the praise (281051). Standalone (the valuation).
soul (nefesh - my soul will be satisfied)
v5: 'My SOUL (nefesh) will be satisfied' - the bearer of the satisfaction; the being-satisfied is the char (281062, bearer=soul). Standalone (the satisfaction-bearer).
v5: 'satisfied as with FAT (cheleb) and rich food' - the choicest fare imaging the soul's fullness in God; the feast-image of satisfaction (281062). Standalone (image).
rich food / fatness (deshen - and rich food)
v5: 'as with fat and RICH FOOD (deshen)' - the sumptuous fare imaging the deep contentment of the soul filled by God; the banquet-image. Standalone (image).
shadow (tsel - the shadow of your wings)

v7: 'in the SHADOW (tsel) of your wings' - the image of God's protective covering under which the psalmist sings; the sheltering (the joyful song is the char, 281079). Standalone (image of God's protection).
v7: 'the shadow of your WINGS (kanaph)' - the image of God sheltering his own like a bird its young (cf Ps57,61); the refuge under which he sings for joy. Standalone (image).
soul (nefesh - my soul clings to you)
v8: 'My SOUL (nefesh) clings to you' - the bearer of the clinging; the cleaving to God is the char (302642, bearer=soul). Standalone (the clinging-bearer).
ruin / destroy (shoah - seek to destroy my life)
v9: 'those who seek to DESTROY (shoah) my life' - the ruin the enemies aim at; their seeking is the char (281080), here the destruction intended. Standalone (the enemies' aim).
life / soul (nefesh - to destroy my life)
v9: 'those who seek to destroy my LIFE (nefesh)' - the psalmist's life, the target of the enemies' seeking (281080); the object hunted. Standalone (the life targeted).
depths / lower parts (tachti - the depths of the earth)
v9: 'shall go down into the DEPTHS (tachti) of the earth' - the underworld/grave, the enemies' fate; the doom of those who seek his life. Standalone (the enemies' fate).
pour out / give over (nagar - given over to the sword)
v10: 'they shall be GIVEN OVER (nagar) to the power of the sword' - the enemies handed to slaughter; their fate of judgment. Standalone (the enemies' fate).
sword (chereb - the power of the sword)
v10: 'to the power of the SWORD (chereb)' - the sword to which the enemies are given; the instrument of their doom. Standalone (image/fate).
v10: 'they shall be a portion for JACKALS (shual)' - the enemies' corpses left to scavengers; the image of their disgraceful end. Standalone (image/fate).
swear (shaba - all who swear by him)
v11: 'all who SWEAR (shaba) by him shall exult' - those loyal to God who take their oaths by him; their exulting is the char (281035), here the mark of allegiance. Standalone (the allegiance).
liars / speakers of falsehood (dabar sheqer - the mouths of liars)
v11: 'the mouths of LIARS (dabar sheqer) will be stopped' - the deceivers whose mouths are silenced; the enemies' lying speech ended in judgment. Standalone (the liars judged).
be stopped / shut (sakar - the mouths of liars will be stopped)
v11: 'the mouths of liars will be STOPPED (sakar)' - the silencing of the deceivers; the vindication of truth that lets the loyal exult (281035). Standalone (the silencing).
